title: Bad Apple
description: As an S-Class agent at the top-secret intel firm Vulture, Adrian “Killy” Rosebarton (Codename: Uno) is the master of seduction, able to charm secrets out of literally anyone regardless of age, gender, or profession. But when he sets his sights on his newest target, Lorenzo “Loren” Stefano, things take a rotten turn. No matter how hard he flirts, Loren just won’t bite - and Uno’s pride (and mission) are about to crumble. If one thing is certain, it’s that this is no ordinary mark. This one’s a bad apple: poisonous if swallowed, impossible to spit out, and dangerously tempting.

title: Cellar
description: A petty thief survives through deception and small-time crimes until rumors of a fortune hidden in the wine cellar of an abandoned mansion tempt them into one last score. But the heist takes a terrifying turn when they accidentally awaken a demon sealed in the darkness below. Trapped in a deadly game of temptation, survival, and desire, escaping may come at a far greater cost than they ever imagined.

title: Black Cherry Picker
description: Dowon lives next door to Irok, a hyung whose life revolves around one night stands something Dowon has grown completely fed up with. Every night, he's forced to endure the sounds of Irok's hookups bleeding through the thin walls. Even when Dowon confronts him, Irok just brushes it off and carries on as if nothing's wrong. To make matters worse, Dowon has started dreaming about Irok, a realization that only convinces him things are bound to get worse. Determined to protect himself, he decides to put distance between them and stop getting dragged into Irok's promiscuous lifestyle.But everything unravels when Irok mistakes Dowon for one of his one night stands, sending all of Dowon's carefully laid plans spiraling out of control.

title: I Was Possessed in an Extremely Private Area
description: Entertainment reporter Lee Joo-won dies in a car accident.When he opens his eyes, he finds himself in the bathtub of a hotel room, possessed by Jung Yeon-woo, a second-generation chaebol and entertainment company executive!Before he can even grasp the situation, the doorbell rings...He opens the door to find the national actor Seo Hee-jae standing before him?! Could it be... I'm Seo Hee-jae's XX partner?

title: A Dragon's Love
description: On a stormy night, hardened mobster Cha San is limping home when he stumbles upon Shin Ro, a dragon bleeding out on the pavement. It’s love at first sight, pulling two entirely different worlds together in an instant. Fast forward to the present, and the unlikely couple is officially navigating newlyweds bliss. To support his beloved, Shin Ro hilariously adapts to human life by taking a job as a car salesman, while Cha San completely leaves his criminal syndicate behind to become a dedicated, apron-wearing stay-at-home husband. Relying entirely on each other, they dive headfirst into a chaotic, sweet, and incredibly steamy new chapter together.

title: Eighteen's Bed
description: There are people in the world who particularly catch others' attention. Jun Kang, who lived as the 'good model student' while secretly hiding his miserable one-sided love, finds himself entangled with Yohan Go, a classmate he now shares a class with in the second year... What if he had liked Yohan Go instead? “Jun, how is it? The taste of first love.”

title: Borderline
description: Mok-yeon receives a proposal for a threesome from his friend and sex partner, Sun-hwa. The other person is Nan-jo, a man that Sun-hwa has been wooing, and while he's great to have around because he's rich and kind, the problem is that he is boring to have sex with. At first, Mok-yeon was just a little curious about Nan-jo, but throughout the threesome, he couldn't take his eyes off Nan-jo. Mokyeon makes a seductive offer to Nan-jo, who wants to save Sun-hwa from him. “I'd like to have a taste of your body, Nan-jo. Would you be willing to spread your legs for me?”

title: Know My Name
description: Unresolved emotions never fade away. Love turns into a wound, and the wound becomes a song, reappearing before him once again after seven years. Bae Yeon Woo, an Olympic silver medallist and professional tennis player. Silver, Song Hyun Seung, the lead vocalist of the top band NIGHTSOUL. Two boys who first met in an abandoned warehouse and became each other’s entire world. However, Yeon Woo, hounded by poverty, debt and violence, leaves South Korea, leaving behind his family, his love and everything else in pursuit of success. Seven years later. Both have reached the pinnacle of their respective worlds. Yeon Woo remains in every one of Hyun Seung’s songs, and Hyun Seung lives on behind every one of Yeon-woo’s victories. “You have always been the greatest regret of my life.” A first love they thought was over—time, which had stood still, begins to flow once more.

title: Claimed by a Wolf
description: *Does "taking responsibility" mean what I think it means?* Fang Li was marked incompletely by a beastman as a child, and has been troubled by his heat periods and pheromones. Years later, a wolf, Karnal, came forward to take responsibility. Fang Li immediately recognizes and fears Karnal as the culprit who often appears in his dreams. An evil ravenous beastman from his dreams or a fervently loyal doggo, which one is the real him?!

title: Koki and Haru
description: 「A world of just the two of us would be fine, you know.」 Koki Taguchi, a second-year high schooler, is secretly dating Haru Higashino — a popular actor who attends the performing arts track at the same school. Dating another guy, on top of someone who lives in the entertainment world, comes with many restrictions. But the feeling of just wanting to be together never changes. Marui Yuuno's beloved social media series, which cuts to the heart of what it means to "like" someone, is finally collected in print.

title: Name Me
description: Ángel once served Enzo Lars, heir to the powerful Lars family, as a servant, but he's now an esper and Enzo is his guide. From the very beginning, Enzo is outlandishly demanding. He wants something personal, intimate, and far beyond protocol. Twisted feelings that should’ve stayed in the past begin to surface again, fueled by power, obsession, and secrets. Behind Enzo’s calculated arrogance lies a dangerous longing, capturing Ángel in a bond he never agreed to and may not be able to escape.

title: Focusing
description: For as long as he can remember, Yun Jeongwu has been the backbone of his struggling family, working tirelessly to support a younger brother plagued by chronic illness. During those long, grueling years, Jeongwu happened upon a newspaper feature about a prodigious young Baduk player named Cha Jihan. Perhaps it was because Jihan shared his brother's age, or because the athlete had successfully overcome his own past health struggles, but Jeongwu found himself projecting his brother's image onto the boy, eventually becoming his most devoted fan. Years later, Jeongwu has secured a position as the youngest staff member at a professional photography studio. It is there that he finally comes face-to-face with his idol, who has now expanded his career into modeling. The professional reunion takes a dark, bewildering turn that night. After a staff dinner, a drowsy Jeongwu retreats to his bedroom, only to be jolted awake by the sensation of wandering hands. Terrified, he stares into the darkness at the intruder. "Ch-Cha Jihan?"

title: Chase You
description: During Do-yoon's childhood, Su-hyun, a university student, tutored him for several years, and it was then that Do-yoon's first love began. However, contact with Su-hyun abruptly ceased without warning, and years later, they reunited at university as student and professor.Yet, unlike Do-yoon who is inexplicably delighted to see him, Soo-hyun distances herself, and he senses the atmosphere has changed..Simultaneously, he hears strange rumours about Soo-hyun circulating among his peers, and thus begins Do-yoon's desperate, reckless pursuit to get entangled with him once more.

title: Senpai-chan's a Man?!
description: Senpai-chan, who looks like a girl, is not only a man, but also seems like an airhead...?!

title: Blood Poker
description: Ha Jae-il, the strongest esper, was reawakened from C-class to A-class. He suffers from severe insomnia due to the lack of guides with high match rates. To make matters worse, he refuses guiding via physical contact due to his past trauma. One day, Ji Seung-hyun, an A-class guide with a 98% match rate, shows up. But he's from the anarchic District 13 and he has no idea how to do even the most basic of guiding tasks. Eventually, the Haon Centre orders him to go to extreme lengths to attempt guiding... which is to have them sleep in the same bed twice a week. That night, Jae-il wakes up to an unfamiliar touch... He wakes up to find Seung-hyun on top of him. "Come here... you have such beautiful eyes..." Seung-hyun's alter ego begins to perform guiding on Jae-il...

title: Playmate
description: Shima Okazaki is gay, in third year of university, and interested in exhibitionism. Just for fun he tries a matchmaking app for people like him and gets a reply immediately. They decide to meet and the other guy, Takeru, looks the complete opposite of Shima. Without even being able to tell Takeru that he's a virgin, they go straight to a hotel. Takeru booked a room specifically for exhibitionism, and as he opens the curtain...

title: What a Catch!
description: From the creator of Hook, Line and Sinker comes its hilarious sequel! Now that Kyesoo and Myungtae are free of Kang Shinjoo, he has his eyes set his next target - Myungtae’s older brother, Youngjoo. And while Youngjoo doesn’t exactly reciprocate the interest, he’s having a hard time forgetting the particularly…perky aspects of Shinjoo’s undeniably flawless physique. Will the smarmy schemer Shinjoo be able to use his charisma to reel in his bait this time? Or is this relationship dead in the water before it even begins?

title: Ikusen no Yoru
description: Growing up in a single parent household with an abusive father, Sora always took comfort in knowing that his best friend and neighbor Tetsuya is always there for him. Their relationship has always been a close one, but when they realize they're beginning to develop feelings for each other beyond the boundaries of "best friends", Tetsuya starts to avoid Sora all together. Will they be able to regain the comfortable friendship they once shared? Or will it all fall apart?

title: Garbage Area
description: Eight years ago, Do Seungho killed his mother— and fled from Shin Jaehee, the only friend who knew his secret. He left his hometown, endured years of hardship, and finally began dreaming of a peaceful future with his loving partner, Youngjin. Seungho truly believed his life was finally settling down… Until one day, Jaehee reappears before him. *“There’s no one in this world who can understand you except me, Seungho.”* Claiming to hold evidence connected to Seungho’s mother’s death, Jaehee drags Seungho’s life back into chaos all over again.

title: Things That Deserve to Die
description: Contract killer Lee Jagyeong’s gun never misses, piercing the heart with flawless precision. It does not matter how bad the target is. He takes the job, kills the mark, gets paid, and that is the end of it. The only things he believes in are his own skills and money. Then one day, a sudden high paying request comes in from a regular client. Five million dollars, with a single condition: Kill Kang Ilhyeon and retrieve one item from his safe. The target is the son of Korea’s crime syndicate kingpin. Kang Ilhyeon is a man with sharp, serpentine eyes. Standing inside a trap Ilhyeon has laid out, Jagyeong finds himself slowly being cornered, the noose tightening around his neck. *“I heard a very interesting story while I was on a business trip to Hong Kong.” “……” “Aren’t you curious what that interesting story is?” “Someone’s trying to kill me. In my own house, no less.” “Explain it. I’ll decide whether to believe you after I hear it.”* Will Jagyeong succeed in killing Kang Ilhyeon and completing the job, or will he meet a pointless death himself? A battle between men who would not be surprising to see dead at any moment has begun.

title: Unromantic Office
description: After working himself to death at a crappy small company, Jung Seon-woo finally succeeds in transferring to a major corporation. With his clean-cut looks, the flattery skills he perfected at the small company, and max-level social skills, Seon-woo is confident he can hold his own anywhere. But that confidence shatters just 30 minutes into his first day... The “new recruit” he lectured with full-on boomer energy—turns out to be someone higher-ranked than him?! He really made a memorable first impression.

title: Bender Rules
description: Haunted by the memory of the day his father died when he was young, Jack—despite being a soldier—is unable to kill anyone. Lost and struggling with this inadequacy, he returns to Italy to avenge his father. There, he meets Reno, the boss of a mafia organization where the person he seeks revenge against is believed to be. After saving Reno's life, Jack uses the incident as an opportunity to join Reno's organization. Determined to prove his worth to Reno, Jack attempts to win him over through pillow talk, successfully securing his place within the organization. But just as Jack officially becomes a member, Reno gives him an order: to kill someone...

title: After a meal
description: One snowy winter day, Chang-deok finds a Jong-woo, a high school student squatting in front of his favourite gukbap restaurant in the snow. Convinced by his promise to cook up the exact same dish as his favourite restaurant, Chang-deok invites him into his home. Unable to resist Jong-woo's proposal to let him stay over for a month in exchange for a delicious dinner every day, the two begin a delicate cohabitation. But Jong-woo seems to be hiding something from Chang-deok...

title: Problematic Student Patrol
description: When delinquent transfer Ban Taehyeon, rumored to be the bawler at the center of a schoolyard fight, walks into class, the strict and upright Kang Hyeonbeom makes it his mission to keep him in check. Determined to reform Taehyeon into a model student, Hyeonbeom starts watching his every move... only to find himself slowly drawn into Taehyeon's orbit. As the line between discipline and friendship starts to blur, could Hyeonbeom really be the one getting "reformed" instead?

title: Jangsaeng Livestock
description: Sim Tae-woo—whose handsome looks and submissive nature had made him the lover of a chaebol family’s notorious black sheep—is suddenly abducted from a hotel and sent to a butcher shop named *Jangsaeng Livestock*. Gu Ja-heon, the shop’s owner, takes Tae-woo under his wing as the young man finds himself entangled in a conspiracy; accepting his predicament, Tae-woo gradually comes to rely on Ja-heon. All the while, completely oblivious to the true purpose behind his abduction.

title: The Meaning of the White Pine
description: Jaehan, a young magistrate newly appointed to the Sangju region, meets Yeonho, known as “Horoja,” the despised eldest son of the powerful Choi family that truly runs the village. Jaehan finds himself growing concerned about the innocent Yeonho, who lives while carrying deep suffering of his own. Yeonho, in turn, feels warmth for the first time in his life from this kind young handsome man and falls for him. But Jaehan is secretly plotting to bring down the Choi family.

title: A Familiar Taste
description: Cheon Woo-jung, searching for a high-paying, short-term job, finds work as a cruise staff member. There, he encounters a passenger who changes everything. "Do you also do interpretation?" "English, and… a little Filipino." "Are you willing to use your mouth for me, Mr. Cheon Woo-jung, and take my money?" the man proposed. Woo-jung needed money, and the man said he needed Woo-jung's mouth. So, all the misunderstanding was Woo-jung's fault for taking his words literally. "Now, shut your top mouth and open your bottom one." "...Huh?" "Interesting. Did you think you'd be doing something grand?" "I think there's been a misunderstanding. I clearly remember you said 'interpretation' then…." "When did I say that?" "You did…." "You're no fun when you act like this, Mr. Cheon Woo-jung. You should be crawling on all fours, begging for affection, and even that wouldn't be enough." By the time he came to his senses, the ship was already sailing in an unexpected direction.
